4:
English speaker notes
The double-U structure follows LViT. CNN features enter the same-scale ViT stages, and reconstructed ViT features V1–V4 return to the decoder. RACE refines only the decoder-bound CNN skips; the CNN encoder continues with the original features. FSDR is inside each up stage and replaces PLAM fusion. The labelled ViT, text and anatomy ports avoid crossing wires. Adaptive filtering is active only at up4 and up3.

中文讲稿
整体保留 LViT 双 U 结构。同尺度 CNN 特征进入 ViT，重建 ViT 特征 V1–V4 返回解码器。RACE 仅精炼发往解码器的 CNN 跳连，编码器主路径继续使用原特征。FSDR 位于每个 up stage 内，替换 PLAM 融合。图中以同名端口连接 ViT、文本和解剖条件，自适应滤波仅作用于 up4/up3。

5:
English speaker notes
PLAM receives the sum of CNN and reconstructed ViT features. FSDR keeps CNN, ViT, decoder and text features separate while computing corrections. It outputs a refined skip Y and decoder D prime before concatenation and two convolutions. D prime equals D at shallow stages. The matched baseline uses our common recipe, not an unchanged reproduction of the official training pipeline.

中文讲稿
PLAM 接收 CNN 与 ViT 重建特征之和。FSDR 在计算修正时保留 CNN、ViT、解码器和文本来源，输出 Y 与 D′ 后再拼接并卷积。浅层 D′=D。匹配基线使用本研究共同配方，不等同于官方完整训练流程原样复现。

6:
English speaker notes
This schematic isolates the semantic-detail paths. Fixed Haar decomposition separates low and high frequencies. Low-frequency CNN, ViT and refined decoder context plus text produce semantic corrections and region support S. S guides high-frequency local and dilated convolution refinement. The original CNN feature bypass is retained. The equation also includes the adaptive residual, whose bank and decoder update appear in the backup. Dashed context ports are schematic; this is not a proof that each mechanism alone causes the measured gain.

中文讲稿
本页突出语义与细节两条路径：Haar 固定分频，低频 CNN、ViT、精炼解码器及文本产生语义修正与区域支持 S；S 引导高频局部/扩张卷积精炼。保留原始 CNN 特征恒等路径。公式中的自适应残差和 D′ 见备份。该图说明设计，不将各内部机制单独宣称为已验证的增益来源。

7:
English speaker notes
Text features are pooled and mapped to six slot logits and probabilities z. The anatomical basis B maps those values to a spatial prior P. CNN features yield visual evidence E; anatomical zone pooling gives q, compared with z to obtain an agreement scalar A. Their product is G. A bounded, initially zero residual scale preserves the identity path. GroupNorm and GELU are omitted from the diagram for clarity and remain in the code. Count and slot auxiliary objectives belong to training; ground truth is not used in inference. Complete RACE is what the three-seed experiment measures.

中文讲稿
文本经过池化与槽位预测得到 z，再与六区域解剖基底 B 形成空间先验 P。CNN 产生视觉证据 E，经区域池化得到 q，与 z 比较得到一致性标量 A。三者相乘为 G，以初始为零的有界残差尺度修正 C。图中为易读省略 GN/GELU，代码保留。计数及槽位辅助目标用于训练，推理无需 GT。三种子实验评价完整 RACE。

English speaker notes
The primary evidence uses a two-by-two architecture ablation across three seeds under one fixed protocol. Dice and Focal weights are 0.5 each, with focal gamma 2. The best checkpoint is selected only by validation macro IoU, then evaluated with a fixed strict threshold. The evaluation is retrospective, not an untouched prospective Test study.

中文讲稿
核心证据为固定配方下两因素四配置、三种子的消融。Dice/Focal 权重均为 0.5，gamma=2。以验证集 macro IoU 选 Best，固定严格 >0.5 阈值后评估 Test。测试集曾用于研究，属于回顾性评价。

English speaker notes
The strongest supported claim is the matched three-seed improvement of FSDR and complete RACE on this dataset and protocol. The combined model improves mean Test IoU by 0.7487 percentage points. Remaining limits include retrospective Test access, split independence, and a single-seed routing-versus-auxiliary diagnosis. Independent-cohort evaluation and repeated mechanism controls are the next evidence needed.

中文讲稿
最强结论是在当前数据集与配方下，三种子匹配实验支持 FSDR 与完整 RACE，组合平均 Test IoU 提高 0.7487 个百分点。限制包括测试集的既往研究使用、数据划分独立性，以及路由/辅助训练诊断仅有单种子。后续需独立队列与重复机制对照。

English speaker script
The completed auxiliary-only control helps separate the two changes. Adding auxiliary objectives produces a Test IoU point estimate of plus 0.1915 percentage points. Enabling routing with those objectives held fixed adds 0.2472 points. Both image-paired confidence intervals cross zero. The complete configuration improves by 0.4387 points, with an interval from 0.1405 to 0.7276 points. This supports improvement of the full configuration on this split and seed. It does not establish that the route alone has a reliable positive effect, and the additive arithmetic is not a proof of independent causal contributions.

中文讲稿
已经完成的仅辅助监督对照将两项变化分开：辅助目标的 Test IoU 点估计为 +0.1915 个百分点，固定辅助目标再开启路由为 +0.2472 个百分点。两者图像配对区间均跨零。完整配置的增益为 +0.4387 个百分点，区间为 [+0.1405,+0.7276]。因此支持该划分和种子上的完整配置改善，但路由独立贡献的证据还不充分，不能把全部提升归因于路由。
